sentences.text: Most twin-screw boats have counter-rotating propellers that cancel each other’s walk.
Twins give tremendous control at low speed.
With one engine ahead and the other astern, the boat spins in place.
Put the starboard engine ahead and the port engine astern to turn to port, and the reverse to turn to starboard.
Around docks, center the rudders and steer with the engines alone, using short bursts of power and plenty of neutral rather than holding the shifters in gear.
